lessons_used: Predictions consistently underpredicted gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 6 tests.
home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 3 of 4 tests.
sign_in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
choose_path copy, home redesign, adoption redesign, and finish new_flow changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a compact grid layout with structured pet trait preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.0% with a median time of 89s; a clear compact layout helps users choose faster.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launch Controls Summary Screen
candidates.change: Add a final controls reference screen before completing onboarding to explain pet desktop interactions.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

new_pet_controls_summary.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_controls_summary.body: Right-click your pet to open settings, talk, or manage visibility on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a new pet controls summary screen after home_intro while keeping all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage has high drop-off and support mentions confusion, but adding new screens has poor performance track record and high dev cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Preparation Activity Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add a companion preview interaction step during the waiting phase while rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs during long render waits.

new_pet_prep_activity.headline: Getting Your Pet Ready
new_pet_prep_activity.body: Preview companion traits and desktop behaviors while background rendering completes.

guard.reason: Adds a companion preparation activity sub-flow during the waiting phase without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time on home screen, but building a sub-flow is high cost with moderate expected impact given 92.1% baseline pass rate.

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Comparison Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column comparison layout highlighting preset vs custom options.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a mean of 514s; presenting clear side-by-side choices reduces decision friction.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Desktop Pet Security Hint
candidates.change: Add a persistent hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in links desktop pet data safely to account credentials.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in hints won 3 of 6 past tests.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to securely link and protect your desktop pet profile across devices.

guard.reason: Adds a security hint to sign-in screen without requesting new personal data.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails, low cost hint change, and sign_in hints have a proven track record (+2.5% avg lift).

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Stage Checklist Display
candidates.change: Display a structured checklist layout on the waiting screen showing generation progress steps.
candidates.why: Home wait step takes a long time (mean 2336s) and wait_info changes won 3 of 4 previous tests.

components.text: Preparing pet model and desktop animations

guard.reason: Displays a preparation checklist on the waiting screen while keeping the pet creation job intact.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes are reliable winners (3 of 4 past tests, +2.6% lift), targeting long wait times.

candidates.title: Story Screen Setup Duration Copy
candidates.change: Update the story screen copy to inform users that onboarding takes less than two minutes.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is 8s with high mean (514s), so setting clear duration expectations early reduces abandonments.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Set up your desktop pet in under 2 minutes. Pick a preset companion or create your own.

guard.reason: Updates story screen copy to explain setup duration while still introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak, but choose_path copy changes have consistently shown no clear positive effect (-0.2% past lift).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Official Mascot Seal
candidates.change: Add a mascot preview seal component to the adoption certificate screen to encourage finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.0%; adding visual completion reward components boosts motivation.

guard.reason: Adds an official adoption seal component to the certificate screen, maintaining the official stamp job.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption step which loses 34% of users, but incentive changes have thin historical evidence (+0.2% on 1 test).

candidates.title: Finish Screen Desktop Controls Notification Hint
candidates.change: Enable notification prompt and add a hint on home_intro explaining how to summon and control the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report confusion after onboarding on how to control or interact with the pet.

home_intro.hint: Your pet lives on your desktop! Right-click or use system tray to access pet controls.

guard.reason: Adds desktop control hints and optional notification prompt to home_intro inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 31.5% of users, support mails confirm post-onboarding confusion, and finish notifications have proven +2.6% lift over 2 tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launch Count Timer Display
candidates.change: Add a visual timer component on the waiting screen to clarify active background preparation status.
candidates.why: Home conversion is 92.1% but has high mean wait time (2336s); timer display improves wait perception.

guard.reason: Adds an estimated time timer for a real background preparation wait on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have strong historical backing (+2.6% across 4 tests), addressing home step wait times.

picked: Finish Screen Desktop Controls Notification Hint
